Package com.csse3200.game.components.loot

Class WeaponStatsPreset

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.loot.WeaponStatsPreset
All Implemented Interfaces:
WeaponStats
public class WeaponStatsPreset extends Object implements WeaponStats
One weapon type's stat block for a single tier. Replaces the private TierStats class - same role, now built directly per type rather than assembled from scattered fields inside getStats().

      damage - value for the attack damage
